blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — Confirmatory tests conducted by the Department of Health (DOH) revealed that 10 Negros Occidental provincial government employees tested positive for illegal drug use. Provincial Administrator Rayfrando Diaz made the announcement on Wednesday, Nov. 11, adding that one employee tested negative while results for three others remain pending. The testing stems from a routine mandatory random drug testing program, during which the provincial government collected urine samples from 1,962 employees, including staff across its seven district hospitals, in October.
